about: The Law Offices of Darren T. Moore, which brands itself MooreJustice, works from Madison Avenue in Manhattan. The firm's name is its attorney's name and its contact page is titled for him, and it publishes no roster page, so nothing on the site names an attorney in the form G5 counts.
290 reviews at 5.0. A free consultation, a 24 hour line and pages in Spanish, published. It publishes no case results we could read.
